messages:
Carmen Li: Hey - trying to find logs for a failing request from staging. I have a trace id: 8b7f9c2d4e6a. Where's the fastest way in Console or via CLI to map trace -> logs? Any quick command or link? :thinking_face:
Ben Ortiz: In Console: Observability -> Traces, paste the trace id in the search bar (or use /traces?q=8b7f9c...). Open the trace, click 'View logs' on the span to jump to Logs view filtered to that trace. Direct URL pattern:
https://console.redwood.ai/observability/traces?query=8b7f9c2d4e6a
Alice Chen: CLI option: use redwoodctl (internal CLI). Example:
```
redwoodctl traces get 8b7f9c2d4e6a --open-logs
# or
redwoodctl logs --filter 'trace_id=8b7f9c2d4e6a' --since 30m
```
That will stream matching logs. You can pipe to jq if you need fields.
Dmitri Popov: If you don't have redwoodctl, you can use our logging endpoint via curl (read-only token required):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://logs-api.redwood.ai/search?trace_id=8b7f9c2d4e6a&limit=200"
```
observability-bot: Reminder: trace->logs linking requires 'observability.view' permission. If you hit 403, ask SRE for temporary grant.
Carmen Li: sweet, thanks! If the trace is old, any tips to widen the search? :slightly_smiling_face:
Ben Ortiz: Use --since/--until window based on trace timestamp, or in Console set time range to 'Last 7 days'. Also try searching by request_id (if you have it) — logs sometimes index request_id but not all services.
Alice Chen: Pro tip: use `--tail 0 --context 200` with redwoodctl logs to get full surrounding logs for a specific request id.
Carmen Li: got it. One more — how can I link this back to an alert? I have an alert id 4621.
Dmitri Popov: Alerts include a "linked traces" section in the alert details page. Open https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/4621 -> Related traces -> click trace id. If that link missing, alert's rule might not capture trace id; we should update rule to include `trace_id` in payload.
Carmen Li: thanks folks, this helps. I'll send a follow-up if I hit perms issues. :thumbsup:
